### Checks that passed in pass 1
- Every t reproduces the packet exactly (whitespace aside); 32 units, p flags only on the two chapter headings and the first unit of each paragraph (units 1 and 8).
- gloss.json contains every novel form (no extras); all four __broaden__ entries began as old entry + ' · ' + new reading.
- Word counts in notes (34, 26, 24) are correct; the eight ፨ and single ፨ in units 6, 25, 31 match the source.

### Findings refused in pass 1
- Names with Geʿez in parentheses in l (Joash (ኢዮአስ), Egypt (ምስር)): odd but harmless and the convention asks for Geʿez forms of names in l; kept.
- ጐንደየ labelled 'G' in the gloss although quadriliteral: 'G' is only the basic stem; not an error.
- ተሱዕ lemma ተስዐቱ: kept the house spelling of the numeral (published ch. 2–8, 29); only the false 'ordinal' claim was fixed.
- ወአንፎ / ወነገፎ / ወአፅግዖ / ዐዋዲ / ይትገሐሡ / ተሰለምዋ / ተዐየኑ / ወአብያጺነሰ / ኀምስቲሆሙ / መባርዲን: could not be resolved without Dillmann; left with (?) in l, i, n and gloss rather than inventing.
- ኀሊኬ (particle ኬ): kept as the draft reads it, already flagged.
- Crux unit 11 (ከመ እመቦ ከመ ይትገሐሡ): the draft already says CRUX and guesses; no better reading available.
- Ordering/`titleEn`/`part` strings: match parts.json cite 'ch. 57–58' and the style of the published parts; unchanged.
